title: Re-enrollment Charge on Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Plans
content:
## Fee schedule clause: re-enrollment charge

**Clause.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, a re-enrollment charge is added to the financed amount: 15.00 when a payment-plan request on the account recorded as cancelled (the record of a plan that ended early because an installment was missed) was requested less than 24 whole months before the handling date, 7.50 when the most recent such request was made 24 through 47 whole months before, and nothing in every other case.

The requests read are the account's payment-plan service requests whose status is cancelled, dated by their request date.

### Charge by the most recent cancelled plan request

| Most recent payment-plan request recorded as cancelled was requested | Re-enrollment charge |
|---|---|
| less than 24 whole months before the handling date | 15.00 |
| 24 through 47 whole months before | 7.50 |
| 48 whole months or more before, or never | nothing |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical histories)

- Cancelled request 23 whole months before: 15.00. Exactly 24 whole months before: 7.50.
- 47 whole months before: 7.50. 48 whole months before: nothing.
- A completed plan request is not a cancelled one and carries no charge.
